title: mception
description: Audits other MCP servers for security risks. Returns safe / caution / unsafe / inconclusive.
summary: Audits other MCP servers for security risks. Returns safe / caution / unsafe / inconclusive.
offersHint: Audits other MCP servers for security risks. Returns safe / caution / unsafe / inconclusive. · Packages: pypi:mception · Env vars: MCEPTION_DATA_DIR, MCEPTION_ENABLE_LLM_JUDGE, MCEPTION_INTROSPECT_TIMEOUT, MCEPTION_OFFLINE

environmentVariables.name: MCEPTION_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where audit reports and rug-pull baselines live. Defaults to ~/.mception.

environmentVariables.name: MCEPTION_OFFLINE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to block outbound HTTP (OSV, registry signals, phantom-repo probes).

environmentVariables.name: MCEPTION_INTROSPECT_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Per-target timeout in seconds for the fetcher + engine pipeline.

environmentVariables.name: MCEPTION_ENABLE_LLM_JUDGE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to enable advisory LLM-assisted classification via MCP sampling. No API key needed.
